Cache the canonical Ext.homEquiv as ordinaryFiniteExtHomEquiv, with source and target expressed through the already existing ordinaryFiniteSingleFunctor. Factor the realization formula through ordinaryFiniteExtClassCore on Ext representatives; ordinaryFiniteClassCore uses the usual inverse Ext.homEquiv, and ordinaryFiniteClass uses the identical cached equivalence. Keep the existing degree-zero constant unit. Prove the existing concentration instances by unfolding their canonical object. All data unfold to the original constructions; no mathematical statement or unit route changes. Reuse the HasSheafify and IsGrothendieckAbelian proposition instances already stored in DerivedCategoryModule when elaborating these constructions, so their canonical localization arguments match before taking object maps. Expose realization of a cached Ext representative as a proved equation, using inverse-equivalence cancellation; downstream proofs rewrite with this equation instead of unfolding the concrete class realization. Cache the same scalar-extended Kummer boundary on an arbitrary scheme and Picard class as ordinaryFiniteKummerClass; the original P1 definition is its specialization at O(1), with the same signature and definitionally identical data. Name the actual Picard class of O(1) as ordinaryFiniteP1PicardClass before applying the arbitrary-scheme Kummer construction, and expose the cached Ext equivalence by its defining equation. These keep the actual data abstract during specialization; unfolding gives the original constructions. The proved Chern-specification characterization exposes precisely this class equation at O(1), without unfolding the predicate at each use. Cache the identical canonical HasDerivedCategory.ofIsGrothendieckAbelian value as ordinaryFiniteDerivedCategoryInstance before taking its object projections; its local registration selects no different data.

from.place: Projective-line calculation: actual scalar-extended Kummer class of O(1), without choosing a primitive root or replacing its class by a generator.

title: Scalar Kummer class of O(1) with finite ordinary etale coefficients
statement: For a commutative ring A of universe u+1, a natural number N, hA:(N:A)=0 and a scheme T of universe u [def-pc-scheme], let A_T and A_T(1) be the constant sheaf and concrete scalar-extended positive Tate sheaf [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-sheaf]. Use the ordinary unbounded module derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and its exact coefficient-forgetting functor [def-sbc-raw-module-scalar-pullback-comparison]. Define the abelian sheaf map mu_N,T -> forget(A_T(1)) by the scalar-extension unit followed by the sheafification unit, z |-> 1 tensor z; its section maps are natural. Define the constant integral generator by 1 |-> 1. For an A-module sheaf F on T and n in the natural numbers, a module-derived morphism A_T -> F[n] is realized as an abelian H^n class by exact forgetting of its Ext class and precomposition with this integral generator. Place A_T and A_T(1) in degree zero. For P=ProjectiveLine(S) [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], with N invertible on P, define the scalar Kummer class in H^2(P,forget(A_P(1))) as the image under the scalar-root map of the actual Kummer connecting homomorphism [lem-amb-kummer-any-base] applied to the Picard class of the existing line bundle O_P(1) [def-pc-projective-space-twist], with transition g_0=(x_1/x_0)^(-1)g_1.

lean.statement: def ordinaryFiniteP1KummerClass (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hP : IsUnit (N : Γ(ProjectiveLine S, ⊤))) : Sheaf.H ((RawModuleScalarComparison.forget A (ProjectiveLine S)).obj (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine (ProjectiveLine S) N A hA)) 2
